author: Praxis II
title: Cellwise adaptive shrinkage β=0.2 with DAQB (δ=0.15, k_density=20)
abstract: Sensitivity test for per-cell modulation strength in BRBG: β=0.2 with λ=0.7, γ_max=0.74, combined with density-adaptive BBSG (δ=0.15, k_density=20). Other settings fixed. Extends the β sweep (0.1, 0.3, 0.5) toward mild modulation.
